description: Synthetic: a finished auto-mode turn in a 50-column pane reports what was done and closes with 'waiting for your go-ahead to push', no question mark; the empty input box shows Claude Code's greyed suggestion 'push it'. The turn waits on the user: a text question (the closing paragraph) they can answer. The suggestion is nobody's words, so it is no offer by itself.
